description.value:
The Satara is an unusual breed both because of its bizarre appearance and its unconventional technological foundation. Instead of firing ordinary buckshot, this electromag shotgun launches small, razor-sharp steel spikes. Critics argue the Satara heaviness and bulkiness make it unreasonably inconvenient for practical use. Its advocates, however, point out that the Serbian shotgun is undeterred by walls. MaxTac officers belong to the latter group. After many trials in the field, the Satara has proved consistently effective at bringing down even the most heavily chromed cyberpsychos.

Cost: 600eb (Expensive)

Class: Shotgun • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: Long Barrel Shotgun

Damage: 5d6 • Capacity: 2 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Shotgun Shell

Concealable: No

Slots: 1 • Attachments: Tech Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: Incompatible with Capacity modifying Attachments. Each of this weapon’s two barrels can load a different ammunition type, with the user choosing which to use when firing this weapon.

Range: Long Barrel Shotgun
Pre-installed: Tech Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Shotgun Shell

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
